name: Industrial Manufacturing for Healthcare
description: Introduction to various manufacturing processes, just-in-time, Kaizen, automation, control systems, industry 4.0, sensing, actuating and communicating technologies: various types of sensors, actuators, wireless communications and PLCs, additive manufacturing: technologies for metal, polymer, ceramic and biological/ organic materials, generative design, haptic devices for patient/subject specific medical device design, IoT based 3D printing, basics of industry 5.0: productivity, robots versus cobots, human-centered design: human factors, design of work spaces, injury prone zones, fatigue reduction, robotics in healthcare, augmented reality/ virtual reality, cobotics in surgery, risk assessment and regulatory affairs.
